intro.en: Estella handles intel gathering and communications for Endfield's Operations Team Z7, hoping her work makes life easier despite her weak stamina and constant misfortune.
intro.zh-TW: 埃特拉是終末地 Z7 行動組成員，負責情報收集與通訊；儘管體力不佳且常伴不幸，仍希望透過工作讓身邊的人過得更輕鬆。

basic.en: Physical combo of up to 4 hits. While she is the controlled operator, her Final Strike also deals 17 Stagger.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 4 段的物理傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊會額外造成 17 點失衡。

battle.en: Thrusts her lance to send a freezing sound wave in a straight line, dealing Cryo damage and applying Cryo Infliction to enemies hit.
battle.zh-TW: 向前刺出長槍激發製冷聲波，對直線上的敵人造成寒冷傷害並施加寒冷附著。

combo.en: Trigger: an enemy suffers Solidification. She dashes beside the target to deal Physical damage and forcibly Lift enemies in a small area; hitting a target with Solidification deals extra damage and applies Physical Susceptibility.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：有敵人進入凍結狀態。迅速移至敵人身邊，對小範圍內敵人造成物理傷害並強制擊飛；命中凍結目標時追加傷害並施加物理脆弱。

ultimate.en: Slams her spear shaft down to deal Physical damage to enemies in a circle around her, forcibly applying Lift to any with Physical Susceptibility.
ultimate.zh-TW: 全力下砸槍柄對自身周圍圓形範圍內的敵人造成物理傷害，並強制擊飛處於物理脆弱狀態的敵人。

talents.en: Triggering Shatter makes the next cast of Onomatopoeia return 7.5 SP (15 SP at Promotion II); this effect does not stack.
talents.zh-TW: 觸發碎冰效果後，下一次施放凝聲會返還 7.5 點技力（精英化II 為 15 點），無法疊加。

talents.en: Estella is immune to Cryo Infliction and takes 10% less Cryo damage (20% less at Promotion III).
talents.zh-TW: 自身不會受到寒冷附著，且承受的寒冷傷害 -10%（精英化III 為 -20%）。

potentials.en: Physical Susceptibility applied by Distortion lasts 3 s longer.
potentials.zh-TW: 失真施加的物理脆弱持續時間延長 3 秒。
震音所需的終結技能量 -10%。

potentials.en: Onomatopoeia's freezing sound wave travels 50% farther and deals +40% damage to the first enemy hit.
potentials.zh-TW: 凝聲激發的製冷聲波飛行距離 +50%，對首個命中的敵人傷害 +40%。

potentials.en: Applying Solidification to an enemy grants Estella 5 Ultimate Energy, at most once every 1 s.
potentials.zh-TW: 有敵人被施加凍結時，自身獲得 5 點終結技能量，每 1 秒最多觸發一次。
